Synopsis
Mob is challenged to a one-on-one fight with Black Vinegar Middle School's shadow leader, Teruki Hanazawa, or Teru. Mob doesn't use his powers, but Teru goes all out on him, destroying everything around him. Teru continues to unleash his incredible power when Mob suddenly remembers a tragedy that happened between him and Ritsu...
Summary
Teruki is shocked to see another esper and comments that he has a lot of questions, but first needs to establish hierarchy. He attacks Mob, but his attack has no effect. Mob tries to reach out for a handshake wanting to be friends, but Teruki is on his guard and backs off. Mob tells Dimple that he won't fight as Arataka Reigen had taught him that people shouldn't use their psychic powers on others as they could hurt others, just like you shouldn't point a knife at a person. Teruki keeps his distance and eventually continues to attack Mob, slamming him to the ground. Dimple asks Teruki if he can call this a draw, as Mob has no desire to fight and continues so he will only get hurt, but Teruki refuses. Having no choice, Dimple uses the remainder of his power and turns it into his usual form, but Teruki erases him easily. Mob recalls the time he spends with Dimple, but decides he is okay with it. As Teruki keeps calling him insignificant and that he won't achieve anything, Mob recalls how Dimple was encouraging him all the time, telling him he could be great, and tells Teruki that thinking about it. Dimple was an okay guy and a better person than Teruki.

The Mob Psycho 100 Wiki page for Episode 5, titled "OCHIMUSHA ~Psychic Power and Me~," details the events of the episode where Mob battles Teruki Hanazawa (Teru), the shadow leader of Black Vinegar Middle School. Teruki, aiming to establish dominance, relentlessly attacks Mob, who refuses to use his psychic powers, adhering to a principle taught by his mentor, Arataka Reigen—that powers should not harm others. As Teruki escalates his aggression, Mob eventually reaches an emotional breaking point, awakening his uncontrollable ???% state. This results in massive destruction but ultimately leads Teruki to reflect on his own reliance on power and repent.

The episode explores themes of restraint, identity, and the impact of power on relationships. Mob's refusal to fight highlights his moral struggle and the traumatic memory of hurting his younger brother, Ritsu. The story culminates in Mob's subconscious power reconstructing the destroyed school, while Teruki acknowledges his flaws, marking significant character developments. The episode is part of the "Teruki Hanazawa Arc" and originally aired on August 8, 2016.
